title: Component list
description: One list file in data/component/. An array of the values a component can take. Each entry pairs the id that a card refers to with the English value. Ids are unique within a list, and an id stays the same for good: correcting a value leaves the id alone.

id.description: The id a card refers to. A word value takes a lowercase id such as instant; a mana symbol takes the symbol as printed, without its braces, such as R.

value.description: The value, named as Wizards of the Coast defines it.
